stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Same caddy, but for jewels now?

stations.title: The screw caddy
stations.text: A class that only ever holds screws.

stations.title: The shelf
stations.text: Repairs wait in a caddy of their own.

captions: Kasimir wants a caddy for jewels, just like the one he wrote for screws.
The screw caddy's class holds screws and nothing else, so jewels have nowhere to go.
You write the caddy once in its header, its type left open, and fill the shelf with it.
The jewels go into a caddy of their own, made from the same class.
Screws, jewels and repairs each have a caddy now. Next, rules written where they are used.
